feeds.title: Women TIES Blog » Bald Women
feeds.description: Here you will get to read posts about bald women related to improving their mental health, motivation, equality in life, and women entrepreneurs written by womenties. Women TIES exists to help women business owners promote their companies, exchange corporate success strategies, and inspire each other to higher levels of entrepreneurial success.

feeds.title: Bald Girls Do Lunch Blog
feeds.description: A blog devoted to helping women with alopecia cope, gain confidence, and feel a sense of community. Bald Girls Do Lunch is a non-profit organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for women with alopecia. We are reserved for providing highly accurate, realistic, and up-to-date information about alopecia areata.

feeds.title: Bald and Fabulous Blog
feeds.description: I have lived with alopecia since I was 8 years old, it took many years of tears and anger, shame and hiding, depression and anxiety to understand that there are many options available for me. So I decided to spread awareness and support for Alopecia Areata through my Bald and Fabulous blog. I believe that whether someone is bald by an autoimmune disease, illness, or from surgery, or by personal choice, they are still fabulous.

feeds.title: Lady Alopecia Blog
feeds.description: I may not have much hair but yes I do have lots to say. I am Emma, a copywriter, yoga teacher and fancy dress fanatic. I've had alopecia areata on and off for most of my life so I am here to inform you about the disease and its treatments, support and empower women and men with alopecia. Check out my articles on alopecia with top treatments, nutritional advice and stress-busting tips. My tales will surely inform, amuse and maybe even inspire you.

feeds.title: Bald is Beautiful on Women Blog
feeds.description: What if a female shaves her head just because it looks really cool without having to justify? So, this blog is dedicated to females who are bald or shave their heads. Bald is Beautiful on Women Blog meant to be educational, informative, and entertaining. Ultimately the goal is to normalize the shaved or bald head of females in our society.
